stable.headline: Animate gets a timeline and a motion for pistons, Claude works with notes, and the axis tools of Cinema 4D arrive.
notes: Animate has a timeline along the bottom, with a new Oscillate motion for pistons and pumps.
Axis Center and the Axis card: centre the axis, reset its rotation, align it, one undo each.
Claude can read, answer and leave notes (78 tools in all).
A selected group shows its parts dimly; Ctrl+click or Shift+click lights up the ones you pick.
Animation can leave the app as a GLB, glTF or video.
Python can come inside the Windows download, so a first start has nothing to install.
